headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveReferenceWord_law
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List ℕ)
  (htotal : ∑ i, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin xs i = ∑ j, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin ys j)
  (hb : Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceBranch xs ys = Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.TraceInputBranch.reference)
  (t : ℕ),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveReferenceWordLaw xs ys htotal hb t =
    Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceLinearScheduledLaw xs ys hb
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceInitialStart xs ys htotal hb)
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceFallback xs ys htotal) t
